outcome: Responses-flavour invocations stream live to the operator while validation still consumes the terminal event's complete response, and the DeepSeek and Qwen reasoning dialects are first-class: plaintext and summary-shaped reasoning are accepted, thinking can be requested, and dialect quirks never fail an honest turn.

exclude: new provider adapters or vendor-keyed Go types

acceptance.text: A responses-flavour profile with stream enabled renders reasoning, text and tool-call deltas live to stderr, and strict validation consumes only the terminal event's embedded complete response, unchanged from the non-streaming path.
The stream ends at response.completed, response.incomplete or response.failed; the dialect sends no [DONE] sentinel and none is required.
DeepSeek plaintext reasoning items (content[].reasoning_text) are accepted alongside encrypted_content.

Qwen summary-shaped reasoning (summary[].summary_text) is accepted, enable_thinking is a first-class request knob on OpenAIProfileConfig, x_details usage fields are tolerated, and reasoning_summary_text.delta renders.

constraints: The reference diff projected as input is the commitment: land exactly those changes, adapted only where the base moved.
Streaming is rendering only; no validation decision may depend on deltas.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository; the candidate diff carries only product changes.
